mission.title: Blackout
mission.description: Stop a wave of rolling blackouts sweeping across the city's power control stations.

npc.say: What th--? There wasn't supposed to be anyone here!
Benvenuto, {player}! Have you brought the refugee?
Looters were destroying my neighborhood. Thank goodness these people found me! I hope there's something left when I go back.

phase.briefing: Although Anome's threat to the Aqueduct appears to have ended with his lieutenant, Phinney, a sudden series of rolling blackouts has gripped the city. Oddly enough, they appear to be following a pattern. I'm sending you to the power control station for a sector that, at the current rate of the blackout's progress, will be losing power shortly. Do what you can to prevent the power outage.

enter.say: Nothin' there. Check around, I guess. All the power lines are scrambling my readings a bit.

done.say:
Looks good there...
Whoops! Spoke too soon! You got company!
That's all of them. Well, that's one less sector that'll get blacked out.

phase.briefing: It is not very surprising to find Anome's forces behind this latest disaster. But this is no time for congratulations, operative. The path of the blackouts formed a wide front. There are more power control stations to protect.

enter.say: Uh-oh, looks like they've beat us there this time.

done.say:
Aha, the power's coming back up. Nice.
Whoops! So are the Unlimit! Man, those guys don't quit!

Place is clean.
Generators and Reactors shutting down power stations--irony?

phase.briefing: Progress of the blackouts has ceased, {player}, but many citizens remain in unstable areas. Looting and fires are significant dangers during this type of emergency. Proceed to the indicated location and assist the citizen you find there.

enter.say: I've got a bluepill signal in there. Power's on, but who knows for how long.

talk.say: Omigosh! He... There were sparks everywhere! I put out the fire, but I think he's...he's...

done.say:
Ouch. Sucks to be that guy.
Okay, get her out of there.
Okay, i-if you say so... I can't believe this is happening...

objective.text: Lead Charlie Runnels out of the building
Do not let Charlie Runnels die

phase.briefing: We are enforcing a strict ceasefire on the gangs in the area during this crisis, {player}. They should allow the citizen to pass unmolested, although they may not be able to resist going after you. Lead Ms. Runnels to the indicated safehouse.

enter.say: That's the spot. Got some good ol' Machine programs in there.
Mama mia! I think I need saving, too!

objective.text: Lead Charlie Runnels to Agent Pace

done.say:
Budda-bing, budda-boom, that's another successful rescue.
Do you think I could get Pace to take care of me if something terrible happened to my home?

Ah, well done, {player}. Do not worry, we will see to it that she and the others being brought here are well cared for.
These humans... Their lives are so fragile. We must watch over them very carefully, rossapillola. I will do my best to console Charlie for her loss. It will be excellent practice for me!
Thank you. These people are with the government... I guess it's safe. Will someone go back and...see to the remains?

objective.text: Do not let Charlie Runnels die

mission.finish: This threat to electrical utilities will not be tolerated, {player}. Guards will be doubled at all power stations. We must remain alert for the next attack, while also endeavoring to neutralize the threat.
